# Bluebook Digital Testing

> College Board's Bluebook is a digital testing platform enabling students to take SAT, PSAT, and AP Exams on computers and tablets with built-in accessibility features and testing tools.

Bluebook supports multiple exam types including SAT Weekend, SAT School Day, PSAT assessments, and Digital AP Exams across Windows, Mac, iPad, and Chromebook devices. The platform provides comprehensive resources for students, educators, and IT professionals to prepare for and administer digital exams.

## Key Topics

- Bluebook digital testing platform
- SAT and PSAT exams
- AP Exams digital administration
- Device compatibility (Windows, Mac, iPad, Chromebook)
- Test Day Toolkit
- Network and device readiness
- Accommodations and assistive technology
- Test preparation and practice
- Device setup and requirements
- Wi-Fi and network configuration
- Student testing tools
- Test administration procedures
- Bluebook app download and installation
- SAT Weekend and SAT School Day
- PSAT/NMSQT and PSAT 8/9

## Getting Started with Bluebook

- [Bluebook Digital Testing | College Board](https://bluebook.collegeboard.org): Bluebook digital testing application overview for students and proctors
- [Bluebook Digital Testing for Students | College Board](https://bluebook.collegeboard.org/students): Main student hub for Bluebook digital testing on SAT and PSAT exams
- [Download the Bluebook Digital Testing App | College Board](https://bluebook.collegeboard.org/students/download-bluebook): Device specifications and Bluebook app download instructions
- [Prepare Your Device – Bluebook | College Board](https://bluebook.collegeboard.org/students/prepare-your-device): Device preparation guide for SAT Weekend and AP Exams testing

- [Practice – Bluebook for Students | College Board](https://bluebook.collegeboard.org/students/practice): Practice tests for SAT and AP Exams using Bluebook application
